scope: Prospective solution explanation, complexity and planning-estimate guidance; same-capture examples, no retrieval/runtime/schema/threshold change.
criteria: Stack and retained/new component roles are explicit; alternatives are not installed together.
Technical work, proposed architecture/data boundaries and product outcome are connected to known goals.
Problems solved and work remaining to the project team are separated.
Complexity explains concrete drivers and scope-changing unknowns.
Time ranges are assumption-bound planning estimates with confidence, phase/scope/person-hour/person-day/calendar distinctions and dependencies, not measured delivery commitments.
Build-from-scratch comparison uses equivalent scope, includes native/existing alternative and ongoing maintenance; no unsupported quantified savings.
RU/EN preserves sources, conditions, estimates and action boundaries.
